mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Maintenance crews will begin chip sealing roads on September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to discuss several new development projects at their meeting on October 5.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival today and Bike the Barns at Badger Prairie County Park today. Also, look out for yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.

In a noteworthy call from September 5, officers investigated a series of vehicles with cheese slices placed on their windshields throughout several city streets, which they identified as a social media trend.
Culver's is closed today for a building remodel, so you will have to wait a little while longer to enjoy their famous flavors when they reopen.
